chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad al-Barqī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbdullāh al-Kāhilī, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: If a people were to worship Allah alone, having no partner for Him, establish the salat, give the zakat, perform the hajj of the House, and fast the month of Ramadan, then say about something Allah did or the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله did, ‘Why was it not done contrary to what was done?’ or find that within their hearts, they would thereby be mushriks.

Then he recited this verse: “But no, by your Lord, they do not believe until they make you judge concerning what has arisen between them, then find within themselves no discomfort regarding what you have decided, and submit with full submission.”
Then Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: Hold fast to submission.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: the obligatory zakat (alms-tax) given as a religious duty
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the prescribed salat (prayer) established as an act of worship
key_terms.بِالتَّسْلِيمِ: with submission; accepting and yielding fully to divine authority
key_terms.حَجُّوا الْبَيْتَ: performed the hajj pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.حَرَجًا: inner discomfort, constriction, or unease toward a divine judgment
key_terms.مُشْرِكِينَ: those guilty of shirk by associating partners with Allah, here through rejecting His judgment
key_terms.يُحَكِّمُوكَ: they make you judge and refer disputes to you for decision
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُوا تَسْلِيمًا: they submit completely and wholly without resistance

ai.seo_question: Does objecting inwardly to the judgment of Allah or His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله affect true faith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true iman requires complete inward and outward submission to the judgment of Allah and His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله. Even if one performs the central acts of worship, inward objection to the divine or Prophetic command contradicts genuine faith and leads to shirk. The cited verse emphasizes that believers must accept the Prophet’s judgment without inner resistance and with full taslim.
